frames.title: A Crash of Reality
text: For a little over decade and a half, you have lived in a peaceful farming village where your family
only responsibilities have been to wake up and tend the crops and herd the sheep. Your family have been good to you, raising
you in a humble wooden abode. You grew up alongside several friends, all of whom share similar qualities in life. Yet
You often have wondered what your true destiny should be, what the outside world is like, if there's more to this world than
the plot of land where you grew up. Often times your family have dismissed such notions as foolhardy, idealisms
that would only shorten ones life and that the only way to live is through humility.

frames.title: A Crash of Reality
text: On this morning though, you have woken up later than usual, the chilled air of a late fall encouraging
an extra hour or two in the comfort of haystuffed bed. Despite the serenity of the moment, a blood curdling bellow
erupts outside. Quickly, you slip a tunic over your head and slip on worn trousers to investigate this
sudden disruption.

frames.title: A Crash of Reality
text: A crowd has gathered in the center of the village, pale faces facing in the same direction. Beyond them
stands a silhouette that you cannot discern from your position as the sun blinds you from this angle.
The figure speaks in an ominous, booming voice that shakes the foundation of your being.
'Peasants of AppleField, you have failed to deliver your annual harvest. For that we must offer a sharp reminder
of your purpose.'

frames.title: A Crash of Reality
text: The glint of metal pierces through the crowd as the villagers step back in horror and scream.
The crowd momentarily parts and you see near the shadowy figure a more diminuitive creature bearing a sharp blade
whose own features mostly are encompassed by the light of the sun except for a pair of hateful, yellow eyes casting
a daring glance at the crowd. Below the feet of the creature lies the crumpled form of your father with a massive slash
across his throat. His body shudders for a few seconds before lying still. From there, the shadowy figure
and his companion march off.
